description: The block's device ID, a row of block_lengths.csv. Only the blocks speed matching timed have a row.

The block's length found by speed matching, in inches, written by jmri/layouts/hart/scripts/infer_block_lengths.py --apply. The operating length (hartlib.block_lengths.operating_lengths): the Dispatcher's block length in tables.xml and the speed-match tools take it over the plan length.
The run it came from: loop1 laps (timed laps of the test loop) or loop2 passes (timed passes from Switch 5 to Switch 15).
Text for people: the method, the spread and the number of laps. The track plan page reads the spread, laps and passes from it.
